snippet.title: Neon Terrarium Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Inspired by Townscaper, Neon Terrarium is a cozy cyberpunk city builder set in the clouds where you build your own skyline. Every building is generated procedurally. Place capsules and pods stacked on top of each other, lantern-lit commercial streets with neon shops, sleek white towers draped in gardens, and red-lit factories full of pipes and silos. As your city grows, new buildings unlock, and the people who move in bring it to life, each with their own routines, relationships, and small dramas to watch unfold.

Currently in early access. Play for free on itch.io: https://jannstudios.itch.io/neon-terrarium
